- Security: require SSO/SAML for admin console + audit logs for compliance with partners; SOC2 may be a future ask.
- Technical asks for SE: sample token/concurrency semantics, ability to set per-project rate ceilings, alerting on quota exhaustion, suggestion for client-side jittered backoff.
- Proposed POC: give 1-week elevated-burst window for onboarding cohort + logs showing X-RateLimit-* headers; test with our traffic generator.
- Pricing: asked for a simple caretaking credit model for first 30 days to handle campaigns.
- Next AE steps: share 'rate-limit best practices' snippet, provide temp elevated key, schedule 30-min sandbox test next week.
